branches.from: FROM Trade t LEFT JOIN StatusType st ON t.T_ST_ID = st.ST_ID LEFT JOIN TradeType tt ON t.T_TT_ID = tt.TT_ID

joins: left join StatusType on trade status id
left join TradeType on trade type id

assumptions: Trade.T_ID is the natural key for dimtrade grain.
Status and type descriptions are obtained from StatusType and TradeType via many-to-one links.
TradeHistory is not required for the dimtrade grain; close date/time are left nullable.
Surrogate keys for broker, date, time, security, company, customer, account are resolved in a later step and are not part of this recipe.
